subject: an accordion whose bellows tie themselves into a knot
pose: compact suspended twist with one keyboard tilted upward
art_direction: 一架手风琴把风箱打成悬空结，瓷白键盘像侧脸扬起，橘红与钴蓝构成得意神态。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create an accordion whose pleated bellows loop into a compact impossible knot while the two keyboard ends remain visibly connected. Tilt one ivory keyboard upward like a self-assured profile, without adding human eyes or a mouth. Use burnt orange folded fabric, cobalt lacquered end panels, and deep charcoal seams. The folds must remain continuous through the knot, inviting a second look rather than becoming random tubing. Light the sculpture with a broad soft key and one crisp blue rim. Center it against warm cream, occupying about three quarters of the square with every protrusion inside a circular crop. Keep the instrument unbranded and omit surrounding music symbols.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
